items.title: About
items.content:
We started as two people answering course questions from a shared office. Today we support every program in the college that teaches online.

What we do

  • Plan new courses and redesign existing ones with faculty
  • Produce video, audio and interactive media for teaching
  • Run workshops on teaching with technology
  • Keep course sites accessible and up to date

How we work

Faculty own their courses. We bring structure, media and a second pair of eyes, and we hand back work they can keep editing.

items.title: Services
items.content: Every service is free to faculty and staff in the college. Pick one below, or contact us if you are not sure where to start.

items.title: Course design
items.content:
A designer works with you over one semester to plan a new course or rebuild an existing one: outcomes, structure, activities and assessments.

Typical time: 4 to 6 meetings, plus build time between them.

items.title: Media production
items.content:
Short lecture videos, interviews, narrated slides and podcasts, recorded in our studio or on location, captioned before they reach students.

Book at least three weeks ahead during the semester.

items.title: Workshops
items.content:
Hour-long sessions on teaching with technology, offered every month and on request for a department.
